en.answer: The first effect of <<12530>> is an Ignition Effect that activates on the field, and can be activated during the turn <<12530>> was Normal or Special Summoned. If it was already destroyed by the effect of <<5114>>, you cannot activate its effect.
en.question: When I Normal Summon a <<12530>> during my Main Phase, <<5114>> is activated and <<12530>> is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard. This turn, can I still activate the first effect of <<12530>>?
